description: Share of 2027 with the Sun's centre (sun) and Earth's centre (earth) above the local LOLA terrain skyline, 2 m mast, 6-hour sampling. Values are uint8 = percent x 2.

global.rowOrder: row 0 at lat 89.5, column 0 at lon -179.5

south.projection: south-polar stereographic: x = rho sin(lon), y = rho cos(lon), row 0 at +y

north.projection: north-polar stereographic: x = rho sin(lon), y = -rho cos(lon), row 0 at +y

terrain: NASA LRO LOLA: 240 m / 1 km south-polar grids and the LDEM_16-based global grid (8 px/deg)
